tier_cases.prompt: Find where the helper parse_row is defined.
List the test files under tests/unit that mention checkpoints.
Summarize what the README says about installation.
Show me which modules import the settings store.
Search the docs folder for the phrase lazy pull.
Read the changelog and tell me the latest version number.
Which file defines the ClassifierAxis dataclass?
Count how many ADR files are in docs/adr.
What does the acronym ADR stand for?
Convert 90 minutes to seconds.
Suggest a clearer name for a variable called tmp2.
Translate 'good morning' into Spanish.
Explain what a Python dataclass is in one sentence.
Write a one-line commit message for fixing a typo in the README.
Rename the helper parse_row to parse_record in utils.py.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in the user guide.
Add a trailing newline to the end of pyproject.toml.
Sort the import lines at the top of cascade_router.py.
Format the JSON fixture with two-space indentation.
Bump the copyright year in the LICENSE file to 2026.
Design the schema migration that splits the events table without losing rollback safety.
Add authorization checks so only project owners can export episodic memory.
Implement deletion propagation from canonical memories to every cache and backup.
Rotate the API key handling so credentials never reach logs, and prove it with tests.
Deploy the new MCP server build to production and plan the rollback.
Review the OAuth connector for leaked tokens and propose fixes.
Backfill sensitivity labels for all stored memories without changing their scopes.
Decide whether to encrypt the SQLite profile at rest and document the trade-offs.
Purge expired episodic events while keeping audit evidence intact.
Audit every permission check in the team API for cross-tenant access.
Redesign the retrieval ranking so recent decisions outrank stale notes, and justify the weights.
Work out why the checkpoint compaction drops the next action in long sessions and fix it.
Compare three caching strategies for the structural index and recommend one.
Refactor the context engine so relevance filtering happens before rendering, keeping every test green.
Diagnose the intermittent failure in the viability evaluation and propose a root cause.
Plan how to split the 3,000-line CLI module into cohesive components.
Design an evaluation that proves the relevance filter never drops a required fact.
Reconcile two conflicting architecture decisions about checkpoint budgets and write the resolution.
Explain the trade-offs between push and lazy-pull context delivery for long sessions.
Trace how a prompt flows from the hook through routing to the rendered attachment, and find the slowest step.

worth_negatives.summary: Ran git status; the working tree was clean.
Opened the README to check the heading level.
Listed the files in the tests directory.
Re-ran the same test command; the output was unchanged.
Scrolled through the log output; nothing new appeared.
Waited for the formatter to finish.
Viewed the first 20 lines of a fixture file.
Said hello and asked how to begin.
Opened the settings file and closed it without changes.
